quotes.text: once the golden grain leaves the hand, dominion passes entirely to the one who gathers it.
She offered zero tribute to the abyss
true communion begins only when trust is weighed, tested, and mutually returned.
protect the five you hold, claim all that is bestowed, and let the frozen barrens rule the foolish.
He offered zero tribute to the misty void

note: Sovereignty lore: after Kael's loss, endorsed heroes send zero and keep all fifteen; R1 'test trust first' hardens into absolute self-possession.

quotes.text: speaks its value aloud so the river remembers the amount
name the wish, give what you can, return with enough to sustain the morrow.

note: Bridge of Ledger, Giver/Receiver; speak amounts aloud; greed or silence only fogs the river; no prescribed response.

quotes.text: the cold phantom of greed whispered to hoard the bounty within silent stone
the Harvester sent eight radiant blossoms back across the rift, keeping seven to nourish the eternal soil.
neither spirit wavered into suspicion.
entrust the full five without hesitation

note: All five sent, eight of fifteen returned every round; whispering greed rejected; mist read as illusion.

quotes.text: To the long fist, a finger's width — never nothing, for the ford must remain a ford.
Close it only on the fist.
Close the channel to the one who proved himself a stone — but never bar it.
blame the Fog once, the weather twice, and the man only at the third.
Osk had answered silence with silence, and felt the cold of it afterward.
Therefore: at the first meeting, pour wide. At the second, pour wide.
So the rule was carved in four lines on the ford-stones:
The Seventh Lamp, Called First Fool
every measure was remembered
A short measure is not yet a theft. But neither is a theft merely fog.
So Tarn opened first, for someone must.
for the one who dared must never be made a fool.
Why so small a flame?
So do not swear the whole jar and then send nothing.
I have not been cheated in three seasons.
he had met a boat and sent it back empty, and met a trickle and returned nothing

note: Smith's numbered lamps: close on the fist, token never nothing, mirror; Smith confesses his own hoarding; ends 'pour wide' twice.
